description.en: The description of the event bus.
Indicates whether the request is successful. The value true indicates that the request is successful.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eventbridge create-event-bus --event-bus-name MyEventBus --description demo --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eventbridge CreateEventBus --region cn-hangzhou --EventBusName MyEventBus --Description demo
